title: Model Launch & Integrations
summary: Manages the launching of models and the configuration, execution, and lifecycle of various external integrations.

nodes.label: Core Model Launch Logic
nodes.title: Core Model Launch Logic
nodes.description: Handles the fundamental processes of launching interactive and embedding models, and managing their basic lifecycle operations.

nodes.label: Integration Launch Framework
nodes.title: Integration Launch Framework
nodes.description: Provides the foundational infrastructure for managing and orchestrating the launch of various external integrations, including TUI interactions and policy handling.

nodes.label: Integration Specific Drivers
nodes.title: Integration Specific Drivers
nodes.description: Contains the specialized logic and configurations for interacting with individual external tools and applications, such as Claude Desktop, Codex, Droid, and VSCode.

nodes.label: Ollama API Service
nodes.title: Ollama API Service
nodes.description: Represents the backend API service that handles model operations, status checks, and data interactions for both core model launches and integrations.

groups.label: Entry Points
groups.title: Module Entry Points
groups.description: The primary interfaces and starting points for initiating model launches and managing integration workflows within the module.

groups.label: Integration Logic
groups.title: Core Integration Logic
groups.description: Encapsulates the specific logic and implementations required for various external tools and applications to function within the system.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: External Service Dependencies
groups.description: Represents external services that the module interacts with to perform its operations, primarily the core Ollama API for model management.
